name: In situ transient grating spectroscopy of thermal diffusivity and SAW speed of Cu-110 during 12.4 MeV Cu6+ ion irradiation at 30 K (variable 30-300 K, high vacuum)
plain_name: Shine lasers on a copper magnet material while an ion beam damages it at 30 K to see how its heat conduction degrades
description: MIT fusion-magnet-materials facility: 13 x 15 x 2 mm sample on a copper strap cooled by a CVi CGR409 cryocooler in a ~1e-4 Pa chamber on the CLASS 1.7 MV Tandetron; TGS laser beams and ion beam overlap on the sample during irradiation at 30 K (apparatus 30-300 K).
keywords: Shine lasers on a copper magnet material while an ion beam damages it at 30 K to see how its heat conduction degrades

sources.citation: Aurora et al., A facility for thermo-mechanical characterization of fusion magnet materials during cryogenic ion irradiation, arXiv:2506.17358 (2025)

reported_equipment: Technology Applications Inc. P50-502 copper thermal strap
MIT CLASS 1.7 MV Tandetron accelerator with SNICS source

requirements.rationale: Irradiation and in situ TGS at 30 K.
Laser TGS beams must reach the sample with the ion beam.
13 x 15 mm footprint, circumscribed diameter 19.85 mm rounded up to 20 mm.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
